about_the_game:
Step onto the dazzling virtual stage and join the AI idol ARIA in a VR rhythm experience like no other.

As a participant in an experimental idol-AI program, you’ll take the spotlight alongside ARIA herself. Feel the pulse of the music and the roar of the crowd as you swing your glowsticks, perform otaku-style dance moves, and fend off mysterious BUG that threaten to corrupt the concert. Keep the rhythm alive—and the show shining bright.

But as the performance unfolds, it becomes clear this is more than just a concert. When the lights fade and the curtain falls, you’ll step backstage to uncover hidden clues and confront the secrets behind ARIA and the world she inhabits.

This is a story of light and sound, of connection and emotion—a journey where rhythm becomes a bond that ties you and ARIA together.

⸻

Key Features

• Immersive Rhythm Gameplay – Swing your glowsticks to the beat and feel the intensity of a live VR concert.

• Otaku-Style Performance System – Inspired by real otaku dance moves, bringing energy and personality to every motion.

• Dynamic “Human-Wall” Challenges – Strike the right poses during song climaxes to keep the rhythm flowing and the audience cheering.

• Backstage Exploration & Mystery – Discover the secrets behind the stage and uncover ARIA’s hidden truth through interactive story moments.

• Cinematic Story & Stage Fusion – A fusion of rhythm, light, and emotion that blurs the line between performance and reality.

  • Processor: Intel core i3-6100H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest3

Recommended:

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
